text:
Assign 26 modules to alpha–delta. Return a module→worker table plus a rule check.

Modules: auth ledger search upload alerts session catalog indexer archive export tenant profile media cache inventory checkout pricing gateway quota backup notify shipping audit webhooks

Owners: alpha webhooks/search/quota; beta tenant/archive/media/session; gamma alerts/export; delta auth. Place the rest freely.

Fixed (mw=max_workers, t=timeout_s, q=queue_depth, b=batch_size, ttl=ttl_s): webhooks mw20 t40; search mw16 q90; archive mw26; ledger mw32; inventory mw16 ttl360; upload ttl360; tenant t75 q440; export ttl270; cache t25; backup q400; media b700; audit ttl510.

Implied: cache mw≥32; notify mw≤6; auth mw≤4; upload b≤200; shipping retry≥8; alerts b≥800; gateway q≥480, mw≤4.

Deps: indexer/search/export/quota→catalog; catalog→auth; profile→webhooks; cache→indexer; gateway→export.

Never (any path): archive→media/upload; alerts→gateway; shipping→inventory.

Order: webhooks<alerts; shipping<checkout; indexer<notify; session<ledger.

Same worker: cache+audit; archive+tenant; export+alerts; webhooks+quota. Different: gateway|upload; audit|webhooks; auth|notify; checkout|tenant.

Files: queues→webhooks; limits→search; hooks→gateway; store→alerts; guard→tenant; fixtures→inventory; worker→notify; codec→backup.
